notes.title: Upcoming CrazyCar HD Remake
notes.notes: We realize that there are so many players who love CrazyCar, and many of them even play for hundreds of hours. To appreciate your love for CrazyCar, we will be releasing a CrazyCar HD Remake in the second half of the year, and we will be using the latest technology such as ray tracing, so stay tuned!
